name: F1 1990
author: Swofty
description: Turns the F1 2026 season into the 1990 season: 1990 teams, drivers, calendar, rules and cars, in Driver Career and Grand Prix.

options.label: Separate profile save
options.description: Keeps this profile's whole game profile and every career in its own save (savegame@f1990), apart from other profiles. Off: 1990 careers sit in their own slots next to the stock careers.

options.label: 1990 Career tile
options.description: Adds a 1990 Career tile next to the 2025 and 2026 Career tiles.

options.label: Dry tyres in Friday qualifying
options.description: At the start of Friday qualifying, makes every unused dry set usable (the game hands them back and only allows inters and wets there). Not needed when no_tyre_allocation turns the allocation off.

options.label: Replay room for 26 cars
options.description: Moves a replay recorder state that outgrows its buffer (per-car systems at the 26-car race start) to a larger buffer. Does nothing while every state fits, as on a 22-car grid.

options.label: Cars
options.description: 22 runs the 11 strongest 1990 teams on the 11 stock 2026 team rows. 26 adds Larrousse and Dallara on Custom Grid Size's two extra teams and needs Custom Grid Size enabled with Cars at 26.

options.label: Hide the F2 and Icons tabs
options.description: Removes the F2 and Icons tabs from the Choose Driver screen. The change sits in persistent.erp, which loads at boot; turn it off if the game stops at boot.

options.label: Delete the stray test save
options.description: One-off: at the next start, deletes savegame@profile#D1990.UEL (left by the first save-separation build) from Steam Cloud. Turn it off again afterwards.

options.label: Career year
options.description: The year the Driver Career starts in.

options.label: Soft sets per session
options.description: New soft tyre sets handed out in each of practice 1, practice 2, Friday qualifying, Saturday qualifying and the race. No medium or hard sets are given.

options.label: No weekend tyre allocation
options.description: Turns off the weekend tyre allocation screen for the 2026 compound class, as the classic class does. Test switch for the Friday qualifying tyre problem.

options.label: Pre-race grid cutscene
options.description: Plays the grid cutscene before the start, which brings the safety car onto the grid.

options.label: Pre-race grid rundown
options.description: Plays the camera run down the grid before the start, which ends on the safety car.

options.label: Steering wheel display
options.description: The dial the 1990 cars show: the F2 dial, with no ERS or override readouts, or the modern F1 dial.

options.label: No active aero
options.description: Turns off the 2026 active aero rules on the 2026 cars.

options.label: ERS
options.description: Removed takes the hybrid system out of the cars. Zeroed keeps it with no harvest, deploy or override, for when removal misbehaves.

options.label: Tyre size
options.description: The tyre radius the 1990 handling files use. 13-inch matches the MP4/5B 13-inch tyre set; Raised also lifts the ride height by the smaller radius.
